The ATCF ID is assigned by US agencies and can be used to compare the storm with other US cyclone-related datasets.  
If two (or more) ATCF tracks make up one storm/then the IDs are separated by a colon.  
The format of the ATCF ID is B<bb><nn><yyyy> where bb is the basin ID/nnn is the number of the storm in that basin and yyyy is the year.  
Possible basin values are: AL: North Atlantic / SL: South Atlantic / EP: East Pacific / WP: West Pacific / SH: Southern Hemisphere / IO: North Indian.  
For the provisional data/other basin identifiers were provided that include: CP: Central Pacific / SP: South Pacific / SI: South Indian / AS: Arabian Sea (North Indian) and BB: Bay of Bengal (North Indian).
